purpose: Record CI failures after the MadGraph7 integration, their causes and focused fixes.

fixes.cause: Hosted jobs launched complete unit-test discovery without the NumPy dependency required by MG7 test modules.
fixes.resolution: Initialize the MG7 configuration and restore/install the existing NumPy/Meson/Ninja environment before tests; use Ubuntu 24.04 consistently with Python 3.12.

fixes.cause: The Ubuntu 22.04 system Python used by generated launchers is older than MG7's required 3.12.
fixes.resolution: Run on Ubuntu 24.04, matching the other MG7 acceptance jobs and generated-launcher interpreter requirement.

fixes.cause: The merge moved a UFO model object_library import under madgraph.models along with static loader utilities. UFO models remain in models/.
fixes.resolution: Restore models.sm.object_library while keeping relocated static utilities in madgraph.models; audit other tracked nonvendor Python imports.

fixes.cause: The loop-induced ggh golden reference still expected the old spin-2-only three-leg helicity guard.
fixes.resolution: Regenerate the ggh loop_matrix reference from the corrected PR478 template; retain three-leg protection and verify the full affected interface IO class and compiled helicity behavior.

fixes.cause: ISR/FSR metadata was initialized false without later updates. The inactive PY6PT FSR guard was also after compilation, so unsupported radiation failed in a submitted job with a generic cluster exception.
fixes.resolution: Derive flags from retained FKS sectors, including multicore survivors, and reject unsupported PY6PT matching before compilation/submission. Preserve ISR-only, fixed-order and offline-reweight behavior.

fixes.cause: The mixed-order gscale test inspected and instrumented the old inline Born cache and APIs that the private-provider implementation replaced.
fixes.resolution: Exercise the native standalone provider using certified diagram powers, numerical fresh-cache references, real HELAS/rescale counters and explicit metadata colour links. Retain all mixed orders and verify QED coupling changes refuse strong-coupling reuse.
negative_controls: A common G power produces a 32.61% numerical mismatch.
Always recomputing gives correct numbers but fails the rescale/HELAS counter assertions.

validation.scope: Focused selections overlap and are reported separately.

suites.scope: Helicity unit tests and physical boosted-real acceptance

static_checks: Both changed workflows parse and restore the required NumPy environment.
Changed Python modules parse; staged diff passes whitespace checks.
AST audit of 1,336 tracked nonvendor Python files found no analogous invalid madgraph.models child imports.
Only the ggh loop snapshot retained the obsolete spin-2-only initialization guard; all affected references now use the corrected guard.
validation.independent_review: Serial/multicore radiation pruning and compatibility mode handling reviewed by a second agent; no blockers.

mirror_infrastructure.cause: MG7 v2 HEPtools cache keys were absent; downstream errors include missing lhapdf-config.
mirror_infrastructure.action: Run the existing warm_cache.yml on MCcntRefactor_Sfun with reset inputs disabled.
